en.quote: No, there were no such plans.
en.head: YouTube became effectively unavailable in Russia.
en.body: Peskov said there were no plans to restrict access to YouTube. Two weeks later, lawmaker Alexander Khinshtein announced measures to slow the service; on 1 March 2025 the communications regulator said YouTube was unavailable in Russia. This documents a substantial restriction in practice, without establishing that a formal blocking plan existed in July 2024.
